title: 16. Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
description: Compress high-dimensional features into orthogonal principal components.

blocks.content:
### Dimensionality Reduction with PCA

PCA projects correlated high-dimensional features onto uncorrelated **Principal Components** maximizing variance.

![PCA 2D Projection](/images/ml/chart_pca_2d.png)

> **Important**: Always standardize features (`StandardScaler`) before running PCA!

#### Cumulative Variance Scree Plot
Choose the number of components capturing $90\%-95\%$ of total dataset variance.

![PCA Scree Plot](/images/ml/chart_scree_plot.png)

blocks.starterCode:
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import numpy as np

X = np.random.randn(100, 5)
X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)
print('Cumulative Variance Ratio:', pca.explained_variance_ratio_.cumsum())
blocks.solutionCode:
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
import numpy as np

X = np.random.randn(100, 5)
X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)
print('Cumulative Variance Ratio:', pca.explained_variance_ratio_.cumsum())
